t.E180.agn: Its use is authorised only in cheese rinds. In 2010 EFSA recommended withdrawing the existing ADI because the data were not sufficient to set one; as intake is about 1,700 times lower than the no-effect level, it saw no safety concern at the authorised use.
t.E180.body: According to the only available data, in rats litholrubine BK is not absorbed and is excreted in the faeces, not the urine.
t.E180.prod: An azo dye produced by chemical synthesis: 2-amino-5-methylbenzenesulfonic acid is diazotised, coupled in an alkaline medium with 3-hydroxy-2-naphthoic acid, and converted to the calcium salt with calcium chloride.
t.E180.regx.0: Withdrawal of the ADI recommended; no safety concern at the authorised use.
t.E180.summary: A synthetic red azo dye. Used only in cheese rinds.
